summary: Mr. Arking discusses the different opinions of Hacham Yossef Sittehon and Hacham Shaul Kassin regarding the proper blessing to recite before eating mahshi and yebraq. He explains their views on whether the outer vegetable or the inside meat and rice mixture is considered the main part of the food determining the blessing. He also reviews what happens if someone recited a different blessing or ate the parts separately.
questions: What blessing do you say on mahshi?
What blessing do you say on yebraq?
Does Hacham Yossef Sittehon agree with Hacham Shaul Kassin about the blessing on grape leaves?
What blessing is recited if the inside of mahshi or yebraq is mostly rice?
